sections.appearance: She has long, wavy black hair. She has a red, sharp-looking choker, and a red rim on her collar. She has sharp teeth. Halo ==== Tsurugi's halo was a bloody red circle dripping from the rim. Uniform ==== She has black messy long hair reaching the floor with straight bangs and two long cowlicks, dark red eyes, and large black disheveled angel wings on the back. She wears a standard uniform, wearing a black sailor dress with red strip on the sleeves, her black tattered skirt tainted with blood splotches all over and red untied ribbon on the neck. She also wears a red webbed choker on her neck, black nail polish, and black boots with red shoelaces. Gym: She was wearing a white athletic t-shirt with black trim on the collar and cuffs, and the Trinity logo on the left chest. She wore black athletic shorts with a white stripe down the sides. She wore black athletic shoes with white soles. Firearm ==== thumb|Blood & Gunpowder|150px She uses a pair of brown sawed-off Winchester Model 1887 lever action shotguns with a blood stained black chrome receiver. Her club's name is imprinted on the left side of the handguard.

sections.personality: At first glance, Tsurugi gives the appearance of a deranged psycho. When in battle, she has a habit of a destroy-first, think-later attitude and often laughs uncontrollably. However whenever she's around Sensei as well as her friends, she easily shows her true colors, she gets very shy, shows her feminine side, and has a heart of gold. And in combat, Tsurugi is actually a professional, calm and thoughtful tactician who always thinks what to do first and what to do last. Appearance === She has long, wavy black hair.
